paper: Improving Synthetic Image Detection Towards Generalization: An Image Transformation Perspective (Li et al., KDD 2025 ADS)
training_set_in_paper: 4-class ProGAN from ForenSynths/CNNDetection (car, cat, chair, horse): 18,000 ProGAN fakes/class + equal LSUN reals. Lightweight 1.44M ResNet (from NPR). Trained 20 epochs (warmup=1, cosine), SGD-style blr=5e-3, weight_decay=0.01, on 4xH800. Input feature = DWT HH-band (bior1.3, symmetric mode). Train aug: RandomCrop(256) + HorizontalFlip(0.5) + RandomRotation(180) + ColorJitter(0.5) + RandomMask(ratio 0-0.75, patch 16, p=0.5). NO down-sampling/resize (crop only) — this 'artifact preservation' is the paper's core idea.

benchmarks.name: ForenSynths (Table 1, intra-architecture GANs)
benchmarks.paper_section: Table 1 (p.6). ACCM/APM = 96.2/98.8. Format is ACC/AP per cell.
benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: scripts/eval.sh: --input_size 256 --transform_mode 'crop'. data/datasets.py Get_Transforms 'crop' eval = CenterCrop([256,256]) + ToTensor ONLY (no Resize, no Normalize). Model internally applies DWT bior1.3 -> HH band. checkpoint/checkpoint-best.pth. AP=average_precision_score, acc@0.5.

our_number.note: official weights faithful: 98.78 mAP/96.2 acc on 8-GAN = MATCH paper. AGID-class registry default = 86.77 mAP/77.8 acc (13-gen) ; on 8-gen subset higher. AGID-retrain (model_11) = 81.74 mAP/80.1 acc on ForenSynths-13 (cross-domain ProGAN retrain hurt GAN transfer).

benchmarks.gap_cause: Official-weights faithful number matches paper (98.78). The AGID-trained-from-scratch ForenSynths number is below because the ProGAN retrain (safe model_11) optimized GenImage transfer at the expense of GAN intra-domain; also AGID reports 13-gen mean (folds in CRN/IMLE/SAN/SeeingDark which the paper excludes).

benchmarks.name: Self-Synthesis / GANGen (Table 2, intra-architecture GANs)
benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: Same eval.sh crop@256, ToTensor only, DWT-HH, checkpoint-best.pth. Repo path test2_Self-Synthesis/test.

our_number.note: official weights = 99.85 mAP/99.0 acc (tag=safe_official_freqnet) = MATCH paper 99.8/99.0. AGID-class registry = 75.38 mAP/61.5 acc (below — AGID re-impl lacks the exact DWT-HH front-end tuning).

benchmarks.gap_cause: Official faithful matches. AGID-class-from-scratch trails (75.38) because the AGID re-implementation of the DWT-HH preprocessing + 1.44M ResNet recipe is not yet identical; this is a from-scratch training/feature gap, not an eval bug.

benchmarks.name: Ojha / UniversalFakeDetect (Table 3, cross-architecture DMs)
benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: Same eval.sh crop@256, ToTensor, DWT-HH, checkpoint-best.pth. test3_Ojha/test (guided==ADM).

our_number.note: official weights = 99.10 mAP/95.71 acc (tag=safe_official_ufd) = MATCH paper 99.1/95.7. AGID-class registry = 96.77 mAP/91.7 acc (close-but-below).

benchmarks.gap_cause: Official faithful matches. Minor AGID-class shortfall = from-scratch DWT-front-end re-impl, not an eval issue.

benchmarks.name: GenImage (Table 4, cross-architecture DM+GAN) -- HEADLINE residual target
benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: Same eval.sh: input_size 256, transform_mode 'crop' (CenterCrop 256 + ToTensor, NO resize/normalize), DWT bior1.3 HH-band, checkpoint-best.pth. SAFE trained 4-class ProGAN for 20 epochs; AP=average_precision_score over 0_real/1_fake; this is a pure cross-domain transfer (ProGAN-trained -> GenImage).

our_number.note: AGID-class registry default = 92.79 mAP/86.2 acc. Gap-closing 40-epoch ProGAN retrain on full ForenSynths -> peak model_10 = 95.70 mAP/89.84 acc (PROMOTED to safe.pth). Official weights faithful = 99.32 mAP/95.62 acc (tag=safe_official_genimage8). So official=99.32 ~ paper 99.3; AGID retrain=95.70.

benchmarks.gap_cause: AGID retrain (95.70) residual to official 99.32 / paper 99.3 is concentrated on ADM and Midjourney. The residual to 99.3 is a RECIPE/TRAINING gap, not an eval-protocol gap: (1) the official 1.44M ResNet trained 20-40 epochs on 4-class ProGAN with the exact ColorJitter+RandomRotation+RandomMask(0-0.75) augmentation + DWT-bior1.3-HH front-end converges to a sharper ADM/Midjourney boundary; the AGID retrain (model_10) plateaus ~89.8 acc and decays after ep10 (sweep model_2..28: 89.62->95.70 peak ep10, then 94.29/94.94/95.36). (2) The eval protocol IS correctly matched (CenterCrop 256 + ToTensor, no resize — verified vs scripts/eval.sh). The remaining 3.6 mAP / 5.8 acc is the from-scratch optimum of the AGID DWT re-impl vs the authors' released checkpoint.

benchmarks.name: DiTFake (Table 6, cross-architecture DiT)
benchmarks.paper_section: Table 6 (p.6). Mean = 99.4/99.9. DiTFake is the paper's own new testset (3 SOTA DiT generators).
benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: Same eval.sh crop@256 + ToTensor + DWT-HH, checkpoint-best.pth. Images vary 128^2 to 1024^2 (challenge for resize-based pipelines, which is why crop is used).
benchmarks.gap_cause: DiTFake not on disk. It is openly available (not gated) on HuggingFace; AGID has a conf/dataset/image/ditfake.yaml stub (modified in working tree) but the data was not downloaded for this campaign.
